treatments.title: Post-punk editorial transmission
treatments.thesis: Voice as sparse punctuation: maximum caption space, personality concentrated at thresholds.

chunks.text: [Instrumental intro]

[Spoken-sung transmission]
Sixty-eight.
Two thousand eight.
Seven returns.
The record turns.
positive_styles: short factual transmissions with long gaps

chunks.text:
[Spoken-sung transmission]
Eleven days.
No margin.
Three nights turn.
positive_styles: voice clipped into three isolated statements

chunks.text:
[Late-pressure breakdown]
One clock.
Six strikes.
Three recoveries.
[Instrumental fortress]

[Final transmission]
Six thousand and twenty-eight matches.
Pull a thread.

treatments.title: Post-punk red-line song
treatments.thesis: A bolder authored song: recurring verbal hook, more colour and humour, greater competition risk.

chunks.text:
[Intro]
First eleven on the paper.
Then the line begins to run.

[Verse]
Sixty-eight to two thousand eight,
number seven keeps the date.
Final goal and season five—
the same red line, still alive.

[Refrain]
Eleven days. No margin.
Three doors. Three turns.
The line holds.
positive_styles: voice doubling only on the words the line holds

chunks.text:
[Breakdown]
After eighty-five—
things become less certain.
One clock. Six strikes.
You may have noticed a pattern.
[Instrumental return]
positive_styles: motorik pulse returns in stripped form

chunks.text:
[Outro]
Six thousand and twenty-eight matches.
Pick one.
Pull a thread.
